# Precasterz

> Precasterz is a precast concrete engineering consultancy in Dubai, UAE. We prepare structural design calculations, design and shop drawings, BOQ and bar bending schedules, and engineering automation tools for precast concrete elements, to ACI 318-19, Eurocode 2, BS, PCI and AISC 360.

- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 50 359 5647
- Email: contact@precasterz.com (careers: careers@precasterz.com)
- Request a quote: https://precasterz.com/contact.html

## Main pages

- [Precast Design, Shop Drawings & Automation](https://precasterz.com/): Precasterz delivers precast concrete structural design, detailed shop drawings, BOQ/BBS, and in-house engineering automation to ACI 318-19 and Eurocode.
- [Precast Engineering Services](https://precasterz.com/services.html): Our precast services: structural design reports, GA and shop drawings, BOQ/BBS preparation, and custom AutoCAD and ETABS automation tools.
- [About Precasterz](https://precasterz.com/about.html): Precasterz is a specialist precast concrete engineering team focused on detailed design, shop drawings, and engineering automation for precast structures.
- [Achievements](https://precasterz.com/Achievements.html): Precasterz milestones, including our HollowCoreSlab plugin for AutoCAD that automates precast slab layouts, openings, shop drawings, and BOQ export.
- [Careers](https://precasterz.com/careers.html): Join Precasterz as a freelance civil engineer or draftsman on precast design and shop-drawing projects. Send your CV to careers@precasterz.com.
- [Contact Precasterz](https://precasterz.com/contact.html): Contact Precasterz for precast concrete design, shop drawings, BOQ/BBS, and automation enquiries. Email contact@precasterz.com to start a project.

## Design calculations

- [Precast Design Calculations](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design.html): Precast design calculations to ACI 318-19, Eurocode, BS and PCI: boundary walls, hollow core slabs, prestressed beams, footings, retaining walls and lifting.
- [Precast Building Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/building-frame-elements-design.html): Precast building design to ACI 318-19 and PCI: frames, corbels, ledge beams, bearing walls and sandwich panels, with connections and lifting.
- [Precast Lifting Design & Anchor Check (ACI 318-19)](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/Lifting.html): Precast lifting design: anchor selection, concrete breakout and shear checks to ACI 318-19, and rigging analysis for safe precast handling.
- [Precast Boundary Wall Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/boundary-wall-design.html): Precast boundary wall design to ACI 318-19, BS 8110 and Eurocode: wind loading, panel wall and beam action, RC columns, footings, and dowel or pocket connections.
- [Precast Firewall Panel Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/firewall-panel-design.html): Precast firewall panel design to BS 8110: wind and blast load, flexure, shear, deflection, crack width, stability, base connection and lifting.
- [Hollow Core Slab Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/hollow-core-slab-design.html): Prestressed hollow core slab design to ACI 318-19, PCI and EN 1168: losses, flexure, shear, camber, bearing and lifting, 150 to 500 mm deep.
- [Precast Double Tee Slab Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/double-tee-design.html): Prestressed double tee slab design to ACI 318-19 and PCI: losses, stresses, flexure, shear, deflection, vibration, dapped ends and lifting.
- [Prestressed Beam & Culvert Cover Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/prestressed-beam-design.html): Prestressed beam and culvert cover design to ACI 318-19 and Eurocode: losses, service stresses, flexure, shear, anchorage, bearing and lifting.
- [Precast Cover Slab Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/cover-slab-design.html): Reinforced precast cover slab design to ACI 318-19: flexure, shear, crack-width control, standard-hook development length, load cases, bearing and lifting.
- [Precast Footing & Foundation Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/footing-foundation-design.html): Precast footing and foundation design to ACI 318-19: bearing, flexure, one-way and punching shear, crack width and pocket connections.
- [Precast Retaining Wall Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/retaining-wall-design.html): Precast retaining wall design to ACI 318-19: sliding, overturning and bearing stability, stem and base design, crack width and lifting.
- [Precast Block & Mass-Concrete Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/precast-block-design.html): Precast block and mass-concrete design to Eurocode 2: flexure, shear, crack width, interface shear reinforcement, base slabs and lifting.
- [Precast Pylon & Signage Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/pylon-signage-design.html): Precast pylon and signage design to ACI 318-19: wind load, footing flexure, one-way and punching shear, crack width and pocket connection.
- [Precast Yard & Handling-Frame Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Detailed-Design/yard-handling-frame-design.html): Precast yard and handling-frame design: stacking stresses, yard foundations to ACI 318-19, and steel saddle and transport frames.

## Shop drawings

- [Precast Shop Drawings](https://precasterz.com/services/shop-drawings.html): Detailed precast concrete shop drawings for manholes, foundations, and structural elements - fabrication-ready, standards-compliant detailing.
- [Precast Manhole Shop Drawings](https://precasterz.com/services/shop-drawings/manholes.html): Fabrication-ready precast manhole shop drawings: reinforcement detailing, sections, lifting provisions, and BBS for precast manhole and chamber units.
- [Precast Foundation Shop Drawings](https://precasterz.com/services/shop-drawings/foundation.html): Detailed precast foundation shop drawings: footing and pile-cap detailing, reinforcement layouts, embedded items, and bar bending schedules.

## Engineering automation, tools and design sheets

- [Engineering Automation Tools for Precast Design](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-automation.html): Custom engineering automation for precast workflows: AutoCAD plugins, BOQ generation, ETABS load combinations, and calculation reporting tools.
- [Precast BOQ Automation](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Bills-of-Quantities.html): Automated bill-of-quantities generation for precast elements - consistent BOQ output from design data, reducing manual take-off errors.
- [ETABS Load Combination Automation Tool](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/ETABS-Load-Combination.html): Automate ETABS load combination generation to ASCE 7 / ACI 318-19 - fewer manual entries and consistent combinations for precast and concrete models.
- [Concise Beam Autoprinter](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Concise-Beam-Autoprinter.html): Automated batch printing of Concise Beam outputs for precast beam design - consistent calculation reports without manual page-by-page export.
- [HollowCoreSlab AutoCAD Plugin](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/HollowCoreSlab.html): The HollowCoreSlab plugin automates precast hollow core slab layouts, openings, shop drawings, and BOQ export inside AutoCAD.
- [Retaining Wall Design Tool with Boundary Wall on Top](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Retaining-Wall-Tool.html): In-house design tool for a retaining wall with a boundary wall on top: earth, surcharge, wind and pool loads, stability, bearing and PDF report.
- [Dapped-End Design Sheet](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Dapped-End-Design-Sheet.html): Design sheet for dapped ends of precast beams and double tees to the PCI Handbook 8th Edition: tension, direct shear, hangers and bar selection.
- [Column Pocket Foundation Design Sheet](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Column-Pocket-Design-Sheet.html): Design sheet for precast column pocket (socket) foundations to ACI 318: wall forces with friction, shear friction, wall flexure and punching.
- [Saddle Frame Design Sheet](https://precasterz.com/services/Engineering-Automation/Saddle-Frame-Design-Sheet.html): Design sheet for steel saddle frames supporting hollow core slabs at openings to AISC 360: plates, built-up sections, welds and deflection.
